name: away-long-interval-in-tolerance
description: A 21-day plant last watered 20 days ago, today and 3 more days away: watered on the first free day, 3 days past its ideal interval, well inside its tolerance: no warning.
why: , Seen in a browser: warnings on plants whose interval is much longer than the away window. Cactus: keep_moist, interval 21 (band 16 to 23), dry tolerance 11. Last 10-21, away 11-10 to 11-13, watered 11-14: gap 24, 3 past the ideal, the stretch made it, 3 <= 11, so no warning. Hand-computed.
